name: take_back_piece
text: A person sits at a table 75cm high, reaches the right hand forward, picks up one chess piece from the near half of the board and brings the hand back toward the chest, reconsidering a move. Left hand on the thigh. Keep seated.

review.reason: 坐姿伸右手到棋盘近侧并收回；手部目标最大误差4.1厘米，坐姿髋部最大误差1.6厘米，无冻结；不含独立捏指。
review.known_limitations: SOMA77 单人源动作；未做运行时火柴人映射与场景接触验收。手指无独立抓取动画。
review.post_export_edits: 仅walk_brisk裁剪记录中的完整周期；其余NPZ保持生成输出原样。
review.constraint_source_note: 临时参考路径仅为来源记录；实际约束数值保存在constraint_targets。
